messages.content: Predict a participant’s response in the Countries Game. Six people represent six anonymous countries in a fixed group for ten announced rounds, each representing a year. Countries decide privately and simultaneously; communication with other participants is disabled. Only the monitor can answer private questions. Each round gives a fresh token endowment, which must be fully divided between economic development for your own country and climate-change mitigation for the shared atmosphere. Tokens cannot be saved for later rounds. Atmospheric quality starts at +20 or -20 as stated in the current condition. In each round it becomes the previous atmospheric quality plus all six countries’ current mitigation tokens minus30. Each mitigation token improves shared quality by1; emissions reduce it by30 every round. Positive quality means green cells and atmospheric benefits, negative quality means red cells and atmospheric losses; this is gradual deterioration, not a probabilistic catastrophe or a special threshold penalty. The participant instructions display round earnings in Colombian pesos(COP):1000COP per economic-development token plus100COP times that round’s atmospheric quality. Everyone receives the same atmospheric benefit/loss. At the end, the original Spanish instructions and record-sheet explanation pay the average of these ten round earnings, added to10000COP already earned for participating; all ten rounds matter. Equivalently, if a normalized round payoff is development+0.1*atmospheric_quality, the game bonus is100COP times the sum of ten normalized payoffs. In the equal condition everyone gets10tokens each round. In the unequal condition three randomly assigned rich countries get14 each and three poor countries get6 each; your assignment remains fixed. After everyone submits a round, the monitor publicly shows group total mitigation and atmospheric quality, while individual countries’ choices remain anonymous. You can record your own choices and calculate round earnings on a spreadsheet. The round form requests economic-development tokens, mitigation tokens, a check that they sum to your endowment, and a prediction of total group mitigation. The group prediction has no separate monetary incentive. Predict the joint allocation. Output only a JSON array [development_tokens,mitigation_tokens] of two nonnegative integers summing to your current endowment, with no explanation.

After everyone submits a round, the monitor publicly shows group total mitigation and atmospheric quality, while individual countries’ choices remain anonymous. You can record your own choices and calculate round earnings on a spreadsheet. The group prediction has no separate monetary incentive. Predict the answer to: How many tokens do you think the group will invest in climate-change mitigation this round? Include all six countries, including yourself. Output only one number from0to60, in tokens, with no explanation.
